· MACD histogram trajectory (5.3189→1.2953): Remaining positive and showing improvement, but weak signal for bullish reversal.

· Current phase diagnosis: Consolidation phase continues, price is sideways after a decline from 52-week highs, searching for direction. Consider buying on break above SMA20, observe selling on break below SMA20.
